title: Account Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including bank reconciliations, bookkeeping, and general accounting tasks.
 Prepare and review financial statements, such as balance sheets, journal entries, and TDS returns.
 Ensure accurate and timely completion of all accounting transactions to maintain compliance with GST regulations.
 Provide support in preparing MIS reports for management review.
 Collaborate with other departments to ensure seamless integration of accounting functions.

Key Skills: Tally,TDS,General Accounting,Book Keeping,GST,Journal Entries,Bank Reconciliation,Balance Sheet
